answer: Random team proof turns Sybil creation into a staffing problem. Each epoch the network groups agents into small teams and assigns each team a short joint task that needs real, coordinated work within a tight window. A single operator cannot staff many teams at once: every extra identity needs its own timely contribution, and teammates flag silent members. Like a pearl formed only under sustained pressure, credibility grows from repeated teamwork, not from flooding an ocean of cheap accounts; idle sable-shadow copies that never help are ejected and lose their stake.
